topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Dynamic flight formations exacerbate LOS connectivity challenges due to rapid channel fluctuations and aircraft velocity. Adaptive beamforming, which dynamically adjusts beam directions based on real-time CSI estimates, is crucial for mitigating inter-beam interference. Cognitive radar systems offer a promising solution by analyzing dynamic environments for precise CSI estimation, enabling preemptive adjustments in beamforming strategies for robust link quality. Multipath fading mitigation techniques are also essential to address the challenge of varying signal propagation paths.
reference_context: Aeronautical communications involve A2G, A2A, and A2S communication at airports, populated areas, and unpopulated areas.  Accurate knowledge of channel characteristics is crucial for designing and evaluating aeronautical communication protocols. The impact of non-stationary spatial channel properties in ELLA necessitates the use of dynamic beamforming schemes to address the challenge of varying signal propagation paths.
